label: MLH Fellowship
source: every repository under github.com/MLH-Fellowship and the upstream repository it was forked from (data/mlh-parents.json, read via the GitHub API), each fork re-verified with gh api repos/MLH-Fellowship/<fork>
note: One row per fork the MLH Fellowship made of an upstream repository - what the program actually publishes, since it names no partner or project list. `o` is the upstream account the fork came from, `url` is the fork itself under MLH-Fellowship, and the description, language and license are read off the UPSTREAM repository, because a fork inherits them and its own copy says nothing. Star counts are deliberately left out: a fork's star count is always zero and would read as popularity. every fork still resolves, so nothing was dropped. 246 forks were crawled and 198 upstream organizations resolved for the same set, with up to 6 sampled repositories each, at /data/mlh-partners.json. Recent MLH batches no longer fork this way, so this is a historical trail of work, not a batch manifest.
